jobs_results.title: Arquitecto Devops/SDLC
jobs_results.description:
¡Aquí en Accenture, estamos cambiando el mundo a través de las soluciones IT más avanzadas del planeta! ¿Quieres formar parte de ello? Si deseas resolver problemas interesantes y dar forma al futuro de la tecnología, nos encantaría que te unas al equipo en nuestras diferentes oficinas! Madrid, Barcelona, Bilbao, Málaga, Sevilla, León, Gijón, Alicante, Girona, Zaragoza...

Estamos buscando un Arquitecto con experiencia en definición de soluciones técnicas en el ámbito de DevOps para formar parte de nuestra plataforma. Se requiere tener buen nivel de inglés

Funciones:
• Desarrollo de soluciones de testing automático y herramientas de orquestación de despliegues (en entornos On premise y Cloud), SDLC.
• Encargado de la definición de los requisitos de integración y traducir dichos requisitos comerciales a la solución tecnológica.
• Implementación de proyectos de plataforma DevOps y Ciclo de vida del SW, metodologías de gestión e implantación de proyectos, arquitectura.

Conocimientos... Técnicos valorables:
• Metodología Agile/DevOps, SCM, Jenkins CI/CD, testing, CloudBees CI/CD & CD/RO, integraciones con Jira y ServiceNow, tecnologías Cloud Native de referencia, orquestación sobre entornos Cloud y Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform, Groovy (Jenkins), Gitlab, Gitbub, gestión código fuente.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Una carrera desafiante y gratificante donde la variedad de oportunidades y proyectos le permite desarrollar su potencial y crecer profesionalmente todos los días. El único lugar donde puede aprender de nuestra experiencia inigualable, trabajando junto a colegas talentosos.

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Your profile

About us:

Signaturit Group is a company that is revolutionizing the way people do business through secure digital transactions. With over 250000 customers in more than 40 countries, we provide electronic signature and digital identification solutions that allow users to sign over 78 million documents digitally.
As a trusted third party, we are eIDAS certified and follow (to the letter!) European standards and the ANSSI General Security Regulation to offer all legal guarantees in terms of securing our customers' online transactions.

We have offices in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and Paris working together to help companies of any size and sector to optimize their administrative tasks related to document signing and digital communication.

Join the team that is building the European leader in trusted digital transactions! For more information, visit www.signaturit.com and follow us on Twitter.

Context:

We are currently seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior DevOps... Engineer to join our Tech team at Signaturit.

In this pivotal role, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives, primarily utilizing Terraform to streamline and enhance our Cloud infrastructure.

What experience and skills do I need?
• Experience working in Linux environments and Amazon Web Services (EC2, ECS, Route 53, Cloudfront, RDS, S3, Redis, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, Lambda).
• Experience working with Terraform to maintain infrastructures deployed in Amazon Web Services.
• Experience working in CI/CD pipelines with GitLab or Jenkins.
• Experience with Orchestration (Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc), Automation.
• Experience in managing revision control system with GIT.
• Good analytical skills.
• Working proficiency in English.

Your mission

What will you do at Signaturit Group?

Infrastructure as Code: Define and maintain robust and scalable infrastructure using Terraform, ensuring a reliable and efficient deployment environment.

CI/CD Pipelines: Develop, automate, and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines using GitLab and Jenkins, enhancing the efficiency and reliability of our software delivery process.

AWS Infrastructure Management: Take charge of our AWS infrastructure, continuously maintaining, evolving, and optimizing to meet our growing needs.

Environment Oversight: Manage all production and QA environments, ensuring high availability and performance.

Monitoring and Alerting: Utilize the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana) for service monitoring, along with CloudWatch, Advisor, Node exporter, Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog for comprehensive infrastructure monitoring.

Collaborative Solution Designing: Assist development teams in designing auto-scalable, fault tolerant, and highly available services, contributing to the resilience and efficiency of our applications.

Migration Projects: Participate in workload migrations from on-premise servers to AWS, leveraging your expertise in cloud computing.

Continuous Improvement: Be an active participant in continuously improving our workflows, processes, and organizational structure, ensuring we remain agile and innovative.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at SignaturIt, your role will be crucial in shaping the future of our technology stack and processes. You'll be part of a team that values expertise, creativity, and collaborative problem-solving.

Why us?

Which benefits do we offer to our team?
• Flexible remote work.
• Working hour flexibility (Mon-Tues 08:00-10:00 / 17:00-19:00, Frid 08:00-10:00 / 15:00-17:00).
• Intensive working day on Fridays, July and August.
• Catering service at the office.
• Health insurance with family discount.
• Technical training with specialized platforms.
• English classes with native teachers.
• Birthday off.
• Referral bonus.
• Flexible compensation plan with Cobee
• Snacks and fruit at the office.

Apply for this position

We have offices in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and Paris working together to help companies of any size and sector to optimize their administrative tasks related to document signing and digital communication.

According to the Organic Law 3/2007 of March 22, Signaturit Group has set itself the goal of promoting the defence and effective application the principle of equality between men and women, avoiding any type of labour discrimination, guaranteeing the same income opportunities, working for the constitution of diverse teams.

Signaturit Group has signed an Equality Plan and within the commitment to comply with it, works to guarantee objectivity, as well as the gender perspective in its selection processes, through specialized training in equality for the people who participate in them

We ensure that IT provision meets the city's current and future needs. We drive the digitalization of the city of Munich and play a pioneering role. Our work and our services make the... city of Munich a digital metropolis that sets standards that its employees are proud of. As part of the IT department, we ensure a modern IT and telecommunications infrastructure, implement professional IT solutions and secure the IT operations of the City of Munich with over 1,200 employees in our own company it@M. In all these activities, you will always work together with your team colleagues and in close coordination with our customers in the district administration department and the fire department, the external product manufacturers, the internal and external partner procedures and our infrastructure teams. Occasionally, the job requires you to work outside of core working hours. This can occasionally lead to weekend work or on-call duty. We therefore expect all applicants to have equality and diversity skills. jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer | TheAgileMonkeys| Full Remote | 50-65K
jobs_results.description:
The team 💁‍♂️

In The Agile Monkeys, there are 70 people of which more than 40 are developers.

They are especially fond of nerds, geeks, and shy, creative, and different individuals. However, they do not like people who claim to know the one truth and believe they are above everything and everybody. They believe that a good team is a thousand times better than any individual. 💙

Here you have a video of the CEO explaining their culture!

The project 🌱

They are a team of full-stack senior software engineers offering development services that focus on serverless applications, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

They have 2 development areas:
• The Services Area: they work with top-notch clients from the US on innovative and technology-relevant projects related to microservices, event-driven architectures, web3, security, and data, among others.
• The Innovation Area: they have their own innovation lab where they create their own products such as Booster, and Mayday for... example.

Your mission 👀

They are looking for a pragmatic, proactive SeniorDevOps Engineer who loves to design, create, and maintain Cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, OCI), look for creative solutions, want to learn and continue growing, and understand the importance of soft skills.

Some of your main responsibilities will include:
• Implement and own the CI pipelines for multiple software ecosystems, the most important ones would be: Java, Maven, Node.Js and Node.Pm.
• Manage CD tooling
• Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting
• Build and maintain highly available production systems. 😉

What do they expect from you 🏅
• Docker
• Design, architecture (multi-region and multi-layer), deployment, and configuration of AWS solutions (ECS, EC2, VPC, S3, EBS, CloudFormation, CloudFront, Elastic Search, etc.)
• Network management.
• Codifying, managing, and testing infrastructure as code.
• Configuration management tools.
• Security operations.
• Firewall (WAF)architecture design and planning, including the configuration of rules and policies, specifically for CISCO and Barracuda products.

😍 It would be great to also have experience with:
• Architecture, design, and management of Azure, Oracle Cloud, or any other Cloud provider.
• Networking: switch and firewall configurations and network design.
• Infrastructure automation using Terraform/Ansible.

Benefits & perks 💎
• Flexible schedule
• At least once a year they try to meet all expenses paid
• Welcome pack with the necessary equipment
• Remote work 100%
• 100% paid medical insurance
• Coaching sessions, nutrition, sports, or yoga.
• English classes, there are two English teachers on staff
• Personalized mentoring plans.
• 22 days of vacation + birthday + 1 Friday or 1 Monday off

Hiring process 🧩
• Cultural interview: An interview to get to know you, and answer questions you may have about the company.
• Tech challenge: they’ll send you a HackerRank test that consists of two exercises. You can solve them using any technology of your preference.
• Project simulation: they'll invite you to a Slack channel and give you a series of requirements for the project. You will have the support of some team members so you can resolve any questions that may arise.
• CEO interview: no one better tell you about all the challenges that are to come!

Let’s have a chat and GetWith us! 😊

Rviewer focuses on Software. Their company has offices in Barcelona. They have a mid-size team that's between 51-200 employees.

You can view their website at https://rviewer.io or find them on Twitter and LinkedIn

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Internal Job Description
DevOps Engineer
Flexible location across Europe, home based
Who are we?
We are the creators of ClinSpark®, the world's first CDISC ODM certified Phase I eSource and clinical trial automation system. ClinSpark (now known as 'IQVIA Clinical eSource) improves the speed, quality and transparency of clinical research. We support a large and growing set of device integrations, enabling data collected from trial subjects, both onsite and remote, to be immediately available for review by study teams and the sponsor.
We're part of IQVIA - a world leader in using data, technology, advanced analytics, and expertise to help customers drive healthcare - and human health - forward.
Learn more here: IQVIA Clinical eSource Platform - IQVIA (https://www.iqvia.com/solutions/research-and-development/clinical-trials/clinical-trial-services-connected-devices/iqvia-clinical-esource-platform)
About you
- You find joy in helping your customers (biopharmaceutical, clinical research... organizations) who are doing important work.
- Creative thinker who strives to solve The Larger Problem when presented with a specific issue.
- Hungry to learn, self motivated, persistent, and detail oriented.
- Strong DevOps and Cloud technologies background. You should love building the tools to support software, collaborating with a cross-functional development team, and applying your creativity and focus.
- We care lots about your real world experience and less about years in industry or titles held.
About the role
- You'll be part of a very tight, highly professional team comprised of domain experts, former clinical research practitioners and engineers tackling all aspects of our business and operations.
- This position is responsible for designing, implementing and supporting technologies that underpin the ClinSpark platform. You'll help to create and manage standardised software development environments, driving improvements to our Developer Experience. For our customer production environments, you'll contribute to automating systems for deployment, monitoring and fault tolerance. You'll be directly engaged with customers on technical implementation questions, as well as troubleshooting their issues.
- Experience and familiarity with Cloud Platforms (preferably Amazon Web Services), Monitoring platforms (preferably Datadog), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, Fluxcd, Helm etc.), CI/CD (BitBucket, Gitlab, Github) are a must.
- This position is fully remote, although, candidates in the UK or EU timezones will be at an advantage.
Requirements
- Bachelors degree computer science, comparable field, or relevant work experience.
- Five (5) years related experience in DevOps, Cloud etc.
- Experience with clinical trials, core labs or medical devices is a plus.
Does this description fit you and do you want to learn more about the actual job? Reach out and talk to us!

You will become part of a distributed team, working in a remote capacity. This approach offers all of us a great deal of freedom and flexibility. We want you to figure out your own work-life balance. Family matters to us. You will receive a competitive salary package.
Are you interested in this position or you know somebody who could be interested, please let us know as soon as possible.

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer - Artificial Intelligence
jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect Is More Than Just a Job…
Our greatest asset is our people, and nothing is more important to us than ensuring that everyone knows that. Each of our 90+ offices has its own individual identity, and each also has its own unique rewards.

We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the Artificial Intelligence team at TransPerfect and build services in Golang, NodeJS, Python, C++, and Kubernetes for millions of users.

You’d be part of a team developing our GlobalLink AI suite, that includes a web portal, APIs, and a scalable artificial intelligence platform based on microservices for which we use a state-of-the-art tech stack, including Kubernetes and Docker containers. Your goal will be to improve our CD/CI approach, automate the operations, and enable the platform to exponentially scale.

You’ll fit within our team if you love solving challenges, you want to make an impact working for the top brands in the world, and you are ambitious and detail oriented. You’ll need to... work with a variety of teams in the US, Europe, and Asia, and make things better every day.

To find out more about our solutions, please visit: https://globallink.transperfect.com/

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the design and operations of our cloud infrastructure (dev, production, QA) in Amazon Web Services and our colocation.
• Run applications on an orchestration platform using tools like Kubernetes, Clipper, and Docker to ensure at least a 99.5% availability.
• Ensure appropriate monitoring and logging, as well as create the right tools for developers to own their pieces of the code with the most autonomy.

Skills and Experience:
• Experience with at least two of the programming languages above and also bash in Linux environments.
• Experience on Kubernetes, Docker, monitoring tools, and CD/CI.
• Good knowledge of AWS.
• Can-do attitude to communicate within a diverse team of developers.
• Previous experience with high-load web applications

jobs_results.description:
¿Dónde vas a trabajar?

Empresa internacional

¿Qué harás en tu nuevo puesto?

Responsibilities
• Document and share any work knowledge, incident experiences, and any improvements with the team
• Participate in mentoring and coaching new and junior employees or new members of team
• Participate and contribute to the community of knowledge sharing of SRE practices. For example, Solution Monitoring program
• Implement solution monitoring and observability monitoring, automate detections and responses
• Implement SLI and SLO measurements and monitoring in our Solution Monitoring
• Conduct Service improvement actions and review with the team using data from SLI and SLO
• Troubleshoot incidents, post-incidents analysis, perform root cause analysis
• Implement workarounds to avoid recurrence of incidents, improvements to monitoring detection
• Implement Observability monitoring and perform distributed tracing analysis of applications
• Deployment of new application releases to the... preproduction and production environments
• Participate and contribute to automation in deployment, automated testing, and monitoring detection
• Collaborate with SQC team on testing automation deployment
• Collaborate with DevOps on continuous delivery
• Participate in solution FAT process and performance tests
• Drive the solution SAT process in collaboration with Development, DevOps, Platform teams
• Participate in the planning and review sessions with Development, DevOps, Platform teams
• Expand and grow the technical knowledge, skillsets, and expertise expected of an SRE
• Create and document any artifacts related to SRE practices, for example, good practices or patterns or customized dashboards or workarounds or troubleshooting methods, solution monitoring and observability improvements.
• ¿A quién buscamos (H/M/D)?

Knowledge, skills:

Language skills: Fluent in English

Others: Good written and verbal communication

Technical skills:

· Experience in troubleshooting or debugging applications and complex systems

· Understand application tracing and log analysis

· Strong knowledge of Linux and VM

· Hands-on experience in Shell Scripts

· Experience in application deployment, and deployment tools (e.g. Jenkins)

· Experience in programming and development at least one programming language (e.g. Python, C, Java, etc).

· Experience with incident resolution and root cause analysis and incident management

· Knowledge and experience in using JIRA, a ITSM ticketing tool and any documentation tools (e.g. Wiki)

· Knowledge and experience in Nagios and Splunk or similar tools

· Knowledge and experience in Dockers, OpenShift, Kubernetes or similar technologies

· Knowledge and experience in automation (e.g. Ansible) will be an advantage

jobs_results.title: DevOps Architect (Individual contributor role)
jobs_results.description:
Binance is the leading global blockchain ecosystem and cryptocurrency infrastructure provider whose suite of financial products includes the world’s largest digital-asset exchange.

Our mission is to accelerate cryptocurrency adoption and increase the freedom of money.

If you’re looking for a fast-paced, mission-driven organization where opportunities to learn and excel are endless, then Binance is the place for you.

We are looking for a Senior DevOps or DevOps Architect to help us push our infrastructure and configuration management to the next level.

You'll have experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining large-scale, complex, highly critical applications.

Your tasks will involve designing, implementing and improving our next-generation infrastructure management. Advancing our infrastructure and architecture, you'll help migrate existing systems while working closely with the Dev and QA teams. They'll find technical solutions to prevent or mitigate production issues... and automate devOps and operations tasks.

Responsibilities:
• Develop, maintain and administer tools which will automate operational activities and improve engineering productivity
• Proposing and driving architecture improvements, recommending process improvements
• Find solutions to production issues after root cause analysis
• Automate continuous delivery and on-demand capacity management solutions
• Developing configuration and infrastructure solutions for internal deployments
• Updating, tracking and resolving technical issues
• Evaluate new technology options and vendor products. Ensuring critical system security through the use of best in class security solutions

Requirements:
• 7+ years of technical experience in a similar role architecting and supporting large scale production systems
• Experienced with cloud services such as AWS and GCP
• Experience in large-scaled distributed environments
• Demonstrated robust programming skill in Python, Go, or similar
• Experience with tools such as Saltstack, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, etc
• Proficiency with Linux
• Bachelor's degree in a technical field

Working at Binance
• Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow and offers excellent career development opportunities
• Work alongside diverse, world-class talent in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless
• Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects
• Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure
• Competitive salary and benefits
• Flexible working hours, remote-first, and casual work attire

Learn more about how Binancians embody the organization’s core values, creating a unified culture that enables collaboration, excellence, and growth.

Apply today to be a part of the Web3 revolution!

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: DEVOPS ENGINEER
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Apptiva Core Technologies, company specialized in SW development, experts in Digital Transformation, Blockchain, IoTs, NFTs, Cloud, every technology based in Javascript, Python and AWS environments.

Job Description

As a DevOps Engineer you will collaborate with product development teams. With a focus on automating builds via CI/CD pipelines and getting code into production as quickly and efficiently as possible.

As well as supporting services before they go live via system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews. You will use automation to scale systems sustainably and help to make improvements, evolving systems and driving change that improves the reliability, speed and security.

Work with IT Product teams to deploy newer version of software in Cloud resources. Collaborate with DevOps teams to make sure new environments meet requirements and conform to best practices.

Qualifications

MANDATORY:
•... Strong knowledge managing Jenkins.
• Strong knowledge writting Helm templates to deploy resources in OpenShift 4.X.
• Experience creating docker images (Dockerfiles and S2I).
• Experience deploying resources and managing them in Kubernetes/OpenShift.
• Experience in Git and Gitflows.
• Experience in Linux.
• ADVANCED English level

NICE TO HAVE:
• Knowledge deploying resources in AWS using Terraform.
• Knowledge architecting solutions in AWS.
• Knowledge in code analysis tools (Sonarqube and GHAS) and creating performance tests (Jmeter).
• Scripting using Python, Bash or similar.

Additional Information

Salary: 40.000 € - 60.000 €
